limits: Self-selected public Google Play reviews from a fixed historical window; not the customer population.
No revenue, plan tier or confirmed cancellation data: cancellation language is expressed intent only.
Labels come from a small model; verifier and golden-set agreement facts show their reliability.
The first and last calendar months of the window are partial.
The baseline score is complaint_count x mean_severity (= severity_sum); it measures review volume weighted by described impact, not business value.
question: Where should the next quarter of product effort go: access, usability, playback, or billing/support?

ranking.description: Customers say basic listening features, such as selecting or skipping songs, are limited or require Premium. Some also say the app prompts them to get Premium or does not work as expected without it.
ranking.name: Free-Tier Features Require Premium

ranking.description: Customers express broad dislike of the app and say it is bad or getting worse. Some mention having problems without specifying what they are.
ranking.name: General dissatisfaction with Spotify

ranking.description: Customers report that ads are annoying, appear too often, or interrupt playlists. One customer says the ads play in Hindi.
ranking.name: Frequent and intrusive ads

ranking.description: Customers report that playback can start unexpectedly or play a different song than the one selected, and that shuffle, playlist playback, and queue controls do not behave as expected. One customer says they cannot play personal music folders on their phone.
ranking.name: Unreliable Playback and Queue Controls

ranking.description: Customers report that updates make the app worse or unusable, that screen tiles take up too much space, and that controls such as shuffle and repeat are hidden. Some also report being unable to turn off notifications or find Spotify Wrapped.
ranking.name: Interface Changes and Hidden Controls

ranking.description: Customers say songs stop or pause during playback, sometimes after only a short time. Some also report songs skipping or not starting automatically.
ranking.name: Playback Stops or Skips Unexpectedly

ranking.description: Customers say the app crashes when they try to play music or does not open, sometimes showing only a black screen. Some also report repeated crashes or general app glitches.
ranking.name: App Crashes or Fails to Open

ranking.description: Customers say they are logged out or unable to log in again, including after changing their password. Some describe difficulty getting into the app or signing in with a mobile number.
ranking.name: Login and Account Access Problems

ranking.description: Customers report offline or network connection errors that prevent playback, including when they say they have internet access. Some also describe trouble casting or controlling playback on another device.
ranking.name: Connection Errors and Cross-Device Playback

ranking.description: Customers say songs, including Bollywood tracks and favorites, are missing, disappearing, or unavailable in the app. One customer also cannot find videos from artists they follow.
ranking.name: Songs Missing or Unavailable

ranking.description: Customers say downloads disappear, are deleted, or become unavailable when they go offline. Some also report that downloaded content will not play or that they cannot find or use the download option.
ranking.name: Downloaded Content Disappears or Won’t Play

ranking.description: Customers report hearing the same songs repeatedly in mixes or shuffle, or getting suggested music and playlists they do not want. Some say recommendations do not match their preferences.
ranking.name: Repetitive or Unwanted Music Recommendations
